# Sometimes There Isn't a Clear Child Yet

Reparenting kind of assumes there's a clear little one in there to love, and for a lot of people there is. But what if you grew up somewhere you only belonged as long as you played somebody else, like a really controlling family or a strict church? Then all this stuff about your little one could leave you wondering who I'm even talking about. Somewhere like that, the real one may never have had room to form.

Maybe you started playing that part when you were still little, and it took over everything. Now "What do I believe?" or "What do I want?" doesn't have a clear answer of your own. They sound like such easy questions, too. Back then, asking might have gotten you in trouble, or laughed at. Or there was just no way to ask. That can make "love yourself" feel pretty empty. Love what? The part you've been playing doesn't feel real. So the pl/ork starts a step earlier, with finding a self or building one.
